source_review: The codec admits exact envelope fields and constants, UTF-8 byte limits, bounded draft strings/checkpoints and finite bounded event counts. Draft-stage incomplete amount strings remain editable and must still pass unchanged plan validation before review.

Restoration creates a private canonical review and replays only supported existing actions. Each supplied event must have exactly the same scalar fields and values as the generated canonical event; current workspace state is not involved in admission.

Accepted evidence comes from recorded approval events; pending evidence belongs only to distinct unapproved checkpoints and is preserved as raw text. Saving reconstructs and compares the complete review snapshot before creating a download.

File reads are canceled by monotonically increasing request identity on replacement/cancel and all substantive form, checkpoint, evidence and lifecycle edits. Stale success and failure both return without mutating the page. Invalid UTF-8 and oversize actual bytes are refused before decode.

Opening is preview-only until explicit Replace workspace. Save during preview preserves the pending choice so the user can first keep current work. Apply assigns the already admitted isolated draft/review, restores pending evidence, renders through existing functions and focuses the relevant heading/field.

Authored strings reach textContent, textarea.value or input.value; no new HTML interpolation, network call, automatic browser storage, payment operation or source dependency is introduced. UI and guide identify unsigned fictional records without an authenticity claim.

All199 unrelated actual-parent leaves and all original controller behavior outside reviewed invalidation hooks are preserved. The canonical model, plan, ledger, fixed example exporter/viewer, and their tests are unchanged.
disposition: Source accepted at this exact head; independent actual-browser receiving and actual-public-head gates remain separate requirements. No deployment is claimed.
